name: Minimap
desc: Top-down terrain minimap, north-up, with a live facing arrow. Toggle with M.

name: Real-Time Shaders
desc: Custom GLSL terrain shaders: soft PCF shadows, animated water, wind sway, gradient fog.

name: Saturation Viewer
desc: Shows exact hunger plus the hidden saturation reserve draining before hunger.

name: Night Vision
desc: Green-tinted low-light vision, auto-activates at night. Toggle with N.

name: Block Outline
desc: Glowing wireframe around the block you are looking at. Toggle with O.

name: Sky Tint
desc: Time-of-day color grading: warm dawns, purple dusks, deep nights. Toggle with Y.

name: Motion FOV
desc: Dynamic field of view that widens with speed for a cinematic feel. Toggle with G.

name: Spyglass
desc: Hold Z to zoom in like a spyglass. Toggle the feature with K.

name: Damage FX
desc: Red screen flash on damage + low-health heartbeat pulse. Toggle with U.

name: Compass Bar
desc: Top-of-screen compass showing your heading. Toggle with X.

name: Dynamic Crosshair
desc: Animated crosshair with hit flash. Toggle with J.

name: Position HUD
desc: Live XYZ coords, heading and light level. Toggle with C.

name: FPS Booster
desc: Auto-tunes render resolution to hold your FPS target. Toggle with P.

name: Fast Shadows
desc: Lower shadow resolution for a big frame-rate win. Toggle with H.

name: Pixel Vision
desc: Retro pixelated low-res look + a huge FPS boost. Toggle with L.

name: Java Bridge
desc: Verify your certified Minecraft Java account with Microsoft, then search any Java server IP for live status. Adds one ⛏️ button when enabled.

name: Critter Template
desc: Example creature mod: a Glimmercap that hops around by day and drops Glow Caps. Clone me to make your own mobs!
